messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 pager fired for policy-engine runtime error during smart-routing evaluation. Symptom: regional fallback loop + incorrect variant mapping observed. links: <http://logs.internal/1932468100>
Joan Li: I'm on it. quick skim: policy-engine crashed with 'panic: integer overflow' from expr_eval.go:210 while evaluating `hash(request.user_id) % 100` in rule set `staged/latency-slice`.
Marcus Reed: who pushed that rule? I see a deploy from platform-tools at 08:05 UTC. It added an expression to bucket users but didn't guard large user_id values (we changed to 64-bit recently).
Tess Nguyen: customer impact estimate: ~1.8% of traffic hit the loop, mostly in us-east-1 and eu-west-2. We have 3 enterprise customers raising latency complaints.
Joan Li: mitigation plan: (1) disable staged/latency-slice (2) pin routing to safe-variant map (3) restart policy-engine replicas in affected regions. Can someone flip the policy?
Omar Ali: running toggle: `rbctl policy disable --id=staged/latency-slice --reason "panic:int-overflow"` -> ok. Applying routing override -> `rbctl routing override --route default --model redwood-recommended@stable --scope region=us-east-1,eu-west-2`
DeploymentBot: Deploy event: rollback requested for change 10234 by @platform-tools -> accepted.
Marcus Reed: I'm seeing policy-engine pods restart but then hit crashloop backoff in eu-west-2 due to requeued bad evaluation of cached rule. Need to clear cached compiled rule or bump policy version.
Joan Li: clear cache and restart should do. `curl -X POST http://policy-engine.local/clear-cache -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/policy-engine -n rtx --region=eu-west-2`.
Marcus Reed: cache cleared, restart in progress. Monitoring logs.
Tess Nguyen: posted initial customer advisory. adding notes to CS tickets.
Omar Ali: after disable + override + restart error rate dropped from 6.5% -> 1.1% within 6 minutes. Wrong-variant returns cease reported by telemetry.
Joan Li: root cause preliminary: expression used 32-bit arithmetic on a user_id value that occasionally exceeds limits, causing integer overflow inside the evaluator, which wasn't catching arithmetic exceptions -> panic -> policy-engine process crash -> smart-routing fell back to emergency mapping which had stale variant mapping and triggered regional thrash.
Marcus Reed: fix to evaluator in flight: switch arithmetic to use safe big.Int for user-supplied ints and add overflow checks. Also wrap eval goroutines with recover() so evaluator returns EvalError instead of crashing entire process.
Joan Li: create canary image `policy-engine:hotfix-intsafe-193246` and deploy to us-east-1 canary pool.
Marcus Reed: canary up. Logs show `eval_error: integer overflow` for offending inputs instead of panic. No crash observed.
Tess Nguyen: running stress test to try reproducing fallback loop. script used:
```
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do
  curl -s -H "X-User: $((RANDOM<<15 | RANDOM))" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}' &
done
wait
```
Marcus Reed: stress run completed. No fallback loops, error rate stable at ~0.9%.
Omar Ali: I'll own rollout to eu-west-2 and watch metrics for 30 minutes. If all green, we'll promote hotfix to prod.
Joan Li: thanks. follow-ups for postmortem: (1) Add integer bounds checking in rule language docs and console preflight (2) Add unit tests for arithmetic edge cases in evaluator (3) Add automatic fast-fail deployment if policy-engine process restarts > 3x in 5m (4) Add mapping verification for emergency routing to ensure variant mapping isn't stale.
Tess Nguyen: CS update sent and major customers notified at 09:20 UTC. Support will follow-up with detailed timeline.
IncidentBot: Pager acknowledged by Joan Li (ack) -> Handoff to Omar Ali at 09:40 UTC.
Marcus Reed: timeline snippet for postmortem draft:
- 08:05 UTC: policy change deployed (platform-tools)
- 08:14 UTC: first errors and wrong-variant reports observed
- 08:17 UTC: pager triggered (IncidentBot)
- 08:22 UTC: staged/latency-slice disabled
- 08:25 UTC: routing override pinned to stable variant map
- 08:28 UTC: cache cleared and restarts in affected regions
- 08:40 UTC: canary hotfix deployed to us-east-1
- 09:05 UTC: canary validated, promotion started
- 09:32 UTC: error rates normalized
Joan Li: lowering severity to SEV3 while we monitor. Good mitigation, nice coordinated handoff. :thumbsup:
Omar Ali: leaving thread open for postmortem notes. I'll re-escalate if metrics degrade.
IncidentBot: Incident 1932468100 resolved to SEV3. Please file a postmortem and link this thread.
